cardOverview.overviewText: A premium card tailored for high-spending individuals, offering unmatched benefits such as complimentary domestic and international lounge access, luxury hotel privileges, milestone rewards, dining discounts, and accelerated EDGE reward points on spending.
cardOverview.bestSuited: Experience, Travel Booking, Hotel Transfer, Pay by Points

benefitRows.name: EazyDiner
benefitRows.offer: 30% off up to INR 1000.|Minimum Order Value INR 3000.|Valid once per card per month
benefitRows.howToAvail: Select the restaurant to be paid on the EazyDiner app.|Enter the amount, and select the offer.|Discount will be applied and net payment will be required to be made.
benefitRows.exclusion:
1. Minimum payment amount to avail the offer on EazyDiner is ₹3000.
2. 30% offer can be availed only once monthly.
3. Maximum discount is ₹1000 in a transaction.
4. Applicable only on 'PayEazy' enabled restaurants on the EazyDiner app.
